reason: The header-extra-info component (components/header-extra-info.js.es6:1) sets no tagName, so Ember wraps it in its own div. That div is the direct child of the `.contents` flex container (header.hbs:2, 94), and `.extra-info-wrapper` (header-extra-info.hbs:1) sits inside it, so the patch's `@include order(2)` (topic.scss:30) does nothing. The layout still looks right because `.panel` gets order(3) and the wrapper div keeps the default order 0, after the logo in DOM order.
